name: Free Online Excel to JSON Converter - Pure Tools
description: Convert Excel (.xlsx) to JSON: select sheets and export as JSON objects or 2D matrix arrays. Runs locally in your browser.
seoDescription: Free online Excel to JSON converter. Upload .xlsx files, select worksheets, and export tabular data to JSON (array of objects or 2D array). Supports using the first row as headers, skipping empty rows, and custom null handling. Runs 100% locally in your browser with zero file uploads.
